# B"H
<!-- Boruch Hashem -->
<!-- Blessed is He -->

# Post-Completion Final Plan

> The Awtsmoos keeps the repaired meadow untouched while its doorway becomes complete;
> Awtsmoos.com gives the browser one icon and the future maintainer one truthful sheet.

## Exact Files to Rewrite or Create

1. `index.html`
	- Rewrite the full 62-line route shell.
	- Add one explicit SVG favicon link after the theme-color metadata.
	- Preserve all existing markup, import map, stylesheet, and compact entry.

2. `mitzvah-world-icon.svg`
	- Create a self-contained 64×64 route icon.
	- Use dark valley green, gold light, and a simple river/path motif.
	- Include B"H comments, title, description, and no external dependencies.

3. `experiments/Awtsmoos/src/test/launcher/mitzvahWorldRouteShell.test.mjs`
	- Read `index.html` and the SVG from disk.
	- Assert one favicon declaration, icon existence, compact entry, runtime root, and no external SVG dependencies.

4. `NEXT_AI_README.md`
	- Rewrite the full handoff around the current compact entry.
	- Name `globalThis.AwtsmoosMitzvahWorld` as the diagnostics surface.
	- Document `scripts/mitzvah-world/buildCompactRuntime.mjs`.
	- Document Drive-backed models and essential-versus-rich boundaries.
	- Link maintainers to `.ai-thoughts/.../14_FINAL_COMPLETION_EVIDENCE.md` and `15_COMPLETION_GATE_CLOSED.md`.

5. `REMAINING_WORK.md`
	- Rewrite the full ledger with every requested repair node closed.
	- Preserve current verified bundle bytes/hash and dated production evidence.
	- Record only future optional enhancements, not unfinished task work.

## Verification Order

1. Read back all five files in full.
2. Check line counts and tabs.
3. Run XML parsing for SVG and the route-shell Node test.
4. Verify HTML structure and direct local file references.
5. Check Git whitespace and exact diff.
6. Commit only the five intended files.
7. Push and atomically deploy.
8. Verify SVG HTTP 200 and correct MIME type.
9. Run a fresh isolated browser trace requiring playable state, six systems, zero failed requests, and zero favicon 404.
10. Repeat movement input proof.
11. Record post-completion evidence and close the hardening chapter.
